receipt.equivalence_review: Queried digital.mcu and role-qualified part results plus the explicit LQFP package record independently substantiate the package mismatch. Exact original N3 mandates BGA for mcu.32-bit; the only pinned MCU block selects STM32F103C8T6 in LQFP-48. Full pinned-catalog inspection confirms no alternate eligible MCU. UNSATISFIED_SELECTION/functions.mcu replays; no invented parts or package substitution.

refusal.reason: The mandatory BGA package cannot be satisfied in the queried catalog. The digital.mcu category search returns only block:mcu-core, whose U1 selects part:st-stm32f103c8t6. The mcu.32-bit part-role search likewise returns only that part; its package: lqfp-48-stm32 record (package:lqfp-48-stm32) has family LQFP-48, not BGA. The BGA package search returns no records. Substitution of this LQFP MCU would violate the explicit BGA-only requirement.
